benchmark.edition: 16th edition, June 2026, in collaboration with Accenture
benchmark.instrument: system performance sub-index, 22 indicators, 60 percent of the ETI
benchmark.licence: All rights reserved. Derived aggregates only, acquisition register SA-006.

coverage.absent_cause: HKG and TWN are absent from the ETI population. They are two of the three states already withheld from the QESIS+ composite under BIG.

prediction.statement: ESE is a stress axis and ETI system performance is a performance score, so convergent validity predicts a negative rank correlation.

role: EXTERNAL BENCHMARK. Not an axis, not an input, not an fsQCA outcome.
what_this_does_not_license: It does not license using ETI as an input to the composite. ETI is itself a weighted composite and the QESIS+ composite is derived from published axes at build time, never carried.

It does not license using ETI as the fsQCA outcome. D-110 KG-4 requires an outcome from outside the index, and ESE already consumes World Bank SAIDI, so an energy-security outcome shares inputs with the conditions.
It is a statement about ESE, which is a DIAGNOSTIC axis excluded from the composite under D-044. It corroborates ESE, not the headline number.
